reviews.author: Yingying
reviews.text: Tried their red bean soup - One with barley and the other with sweet potato. I prefer the one with barley even though the sweet potato was also pretty good as well. The serving was generous and staff were also very nice too.

reviews.author: Lionel Ling
reviews.text: Pleasant warm dessert on a cold day. Not too sweet. Total damage is a respectable 31 cny. Nice service by the boss as well thumbs up.

reviews.author: Swee Chye Loh
reviews.text: Ordered a bowl of mixed dessert at a cost of 24 yuan. Food was nice and service was fast. Ordering at be done either at the counter or through scanning of QR via WeChat. There are two levels of seats available.

reviews.author: Husnain Mohammad
reviews.text: The tower is colourful and beautiful. It’s definitely a must visit in Guangzhou. The night view here is great. Come during sunset time and you won’t regret. Do note that this place is quite crowded during weekends and holidays

reviews.author: Colin Leung
reviews.text: Most iconic landmark in Guangzhou.  Must visit, A+ attraction.  Beautiful both during the day and night.  Also costs like $50+ to go up it with several tiers costing more.  Recommend to go early as crowds build up at night.

reviews.author: Alaa Aljanaby
reviews.text: Canton Tower is a must-visit attraction in Guangzhou. It’s an impressive landmark and looks spectacular, especially in the evening when it is fully illuminated.

reviews.author: Sơn Ca Nguyễn
reviews.text: Gate A doesn't have an elevator, so going up is a bit tiring. It's about 500 meters from Gate A to Shangxiajiu Street. The goods here are relatively cheap, much cheaper than buying them on Beijing's pedestrian streets.

reviews.author: Jenny Cecilia Prado Viteri
reviews.text: A typical city shopping destination, it's close to many restaurants, individual shops, and shopping centers.

reviews.author: Iyan
reviews.text: Nice , clean and spacious MRT station for famous tourist destination

reviews.author: Cola Bank
reviews.text: Yet another great theme park. They shut down their old 10 loop coaster( it was really rough when I went last time) and replaced it with a really good launch coaster. The acceleration, windiness and ride was just butter smooth and I loved it.

reviews.author: NOOR MOHAMMAD
reviews.text: Chimelong Paradise is one of the most exciting and well-maintained amusement parks in China, located in Guangzhou. The park offers a wide variety of thrilling rides, including world-class roller coasters that are perfect for adrenaline lovers.

reviews.author: ZhanYuan
reviews.text: Getting here is pretty easy. When exit the metro station, there will be many different people that want to sell ponchos and delivery service to the theme park or resort. Booking tickets in advance will be better because counter was quite slow.

reviews.author: Occasionalfoodie
reviews.text: We checked into the hotel during my daughter’s birthday month and she was delighted to see the birthday decorations in the room and there was a very cute complimentary birthday cake for her. It was a pleasant stay and the rooms were clean and new.

reviews.author: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: Is located very near the Circus about 5 minutes walk. Whole hotel is very neat and fun for kids. Love the idea to have some live animals as part of the hotel viewing section.

reviews.author: Afonsinhotravels
reviews.text: The Panda Hotel is nicely decorated for the kids, as the looby and the rooms. Their guests are mainly families to the Chimelong World parks around.

reviews.author: Aileen Chin
reviews.text: Authentic dim sum restaurant with a spacious and clean dining environment. The food was fresh, well-prepared, and overall very enjoyable. Service was comfortable and unhurried, so there was no rush to leave after the meal.

reviews.author: Tulaya Khangtatswas
reviews.text: So delicious and price is surprisingly affordable compared to quality. Staff are lovely and well-trained. This is another reason for me to visit Guangzhou.

reviews.author: 김기천
reviews.text: The meal begins with warm tea. In addition to dim sum, the noodles and rice are also delicious. It is a restaurant with a long tradition.

reviews.author: Ichigo Hirukawa
reviews.text: Huge underground mall with lots of entertainment, clothing and food. Can find fashionable clothes at low prices here. A must visit in Guangzhou. We couldn't finish exploring the mall in one night.

reviews.author: Wee X Y
reviews.text: alot alot of toy shops in the underground. The place is huge and there is a separate food section & clothes section. Sometimes u might get lost & walk round & round. Exits are bathrooms are difficult to find. Seems like a popular weekend local hangout.

reviews.author: Kevin k
reviews.text: 11/10 - Has more unique Japanese things than the other weeb location, 广州动漫星城广场. It’s a bit of a maze, walk past the clothing area to get to the Japanese anime and pop culture goods. Also has a lot of cafes and Chinese boyloves anime goods.

reviews.author: K T Lim
reviews.text: Excellent IG spot - Start with 10 am Wong Fei Hong Kungfu & Lion Dance performance, tour Emperor HuangDi Temple and finished with Ip Man Museum - Grandmaster of Wing Chun Kungfu. Half day.

reviews.author: KT Lim
reviews.text: Must visit Temple of Emperor HuangDi . Together with Ip Man Museum _ famous Martial Art Grandmaster who coached legendary Hollywood Bruce Lee And watch Wong Fei Hong Troup perform Lion Dance at 10 am in front of his memorial hall/square..

reviews.author: KeeTat Lee
reviews.text: Foshan Ancestral Temple (佛山祖庙) A must-visit cultural landmark in Foshan with rich Lingnan heritage and impressive traditional architecture. Ticket: ¥20 for adults

reviews.author: Joana
reviews.text: I had a pleasant experience at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The airport is clean, modern, and well maintained. There are plenty of comfortable chairs throughout the terminals, making it easy to relax while waiting for a flight.

reviews.author: Ismail Faseeh
reviews.text: Had a very positive experience at Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport. The airport is huge, modern, clean, and very well maintained. Despite its size, everything is well organized, with clear signage that makes it relatively easy to navigate.

reviews.author: T3rby
reviews.text: Baiyun Airport’s new terminal opened last October, and the overall look immediately reminded me of some futuristic architecture in the Middle East.

reviews.author: ImmersiveWalk
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning square! The view of the Canton Tower and the surrounding skyscrapers is breathtaking, especially at night. It’s the perfect place for a walk.

reviews.author: Dejan Braki
reviews.text: Huacheng square is the epicenter of modern Guangzhou, located on the opposite side of Canton tower and Pearl river.

reviews.author: Teck Chong Law
reviews.text: This is a nice park on the street level with a huge shopping mall underground.

reviews.author: Kevin Chan
reviews.text: This temple have almost any version of Buddhist deity inside and also it’s one of the temple sanction by multiple emperor of different era. Very well preserve

reviews.author: Avigdor Hait
reviews.text: A very beautiful and colorful place, a must visit.

reviews.author: hsu ting Lo
reviews.text: It's cheap, definitely a long-established Guangzhou restaurant. The coconut tarts are also quite good.

reviews.author: Ethan
reviews.text: Brought here by a native Hong Kong friend, which already felt like a great sign—and it definitely lived up to the recommendation. The place was absolutely bustling with locals, giving it that authentic cha chaan teng atmosphere.

reviews.author: BOUNCINGPLACES Level 9
reviews.text: Lan Fong Yuen is basically a Hong Kong institution. It started way back in 1952 and is the absolute birthplace of that famous "silk stocking" milk tea everyone raves about.

reviews.author: Ashwini Prabhu
reviews.text: Wanted to try a local favourite. We tried the hot and cold milk tea, Pineapple bun, French toast. The tea was mildly sweet and smooth. The pineapple bun was good. The French toast was alright.

reviews.author: Anupam Sah
reviews.text: Visited Madame Tussauds Hong Kong on Victoria Peak and it was a highlight of our trip.

reviews.author: Fabyana Ong
reviews.text: It was so quiet during our visit on 15th oct , so we managed to took pictures without having to wait in line, it was so pleasant, the staff were nice too. My kid loved the projection games on the floor and dancing on the stages.

reviews.author: sarath krishnan
reviews.text: Felt bigger than Singapore one...there is lot of spots for taking photos apart from celebrity statues

reviews.author: Junhua Chen
reviews.text: A decent breakfast place, it opens at 6am! 干炒牛河 Beef stir fry noodles is really good. And the 猪肝粥 pork liver congee is also good.

reviews.author: Rock kid Brothers
reviews.text: The beef chow fun portion is roughly for four people, so please consider this before ordering. It's a bit oily, but the taste is good.

reviews.author: cat
reviews.text: The only thing I love from them is the fried dough, definitely the best in the city.

reviews.author: akhil shanbhag
reviews.text: Bought tickets at the counter - waited in the queue about 10 minutes on a Sunday morning. Queue moves fast. Paid with credit card.

reviews.author: K Ooi
reviews.text: The Peak Tram is definitely one of the must-try experiences when visiting Hong Kong.

reviews.author: Thameur Hamza
reviews.text: Riding The Peak Tram is an absolute must-do historical and visual journey that seamlessly links the high-rises of Central to the cool heights of Victoria Peak!

reviews.author: Hussain Buzaid
reviews.text: Huge wholesale market with average quality and cheap prices.

reviews.author: Quang Si
reviews.text: very very busy. shops and people everywhere.

reviews.author: ng jiannan
reviews.text: A huge park great for strolling, relax and have a picnic. It is interlinked by park connectors by the Shenzhen bay area. Amazing photo spots for Shenzhen's iconic building landscape.

reviews.author: sokhanearyroat ung
reviews.text: beautiful park, beautiful night view with a sea of skyscrapers facing the park😍the buildings lights are connected and there is a song 🎶 with lyrics displayed on the buildings. it was so lovely to stroll at Talent Park in the evening!

reviews.author: Joe Macpherson
reviews.text: Great park by day or night.  Lots of beautiful buildings and statues.  Perfect for a morning or night walk

reviews.author: Soko 37 (Soko37)
reviews.text: Very easy access to other side of the bay, just 10min in good weather and decent price. Possibility to buy something before boarding. Connection to many bus lines and metro line Tsim Sha Tsui. Very convenient interval for ferry

reviews.author: Lueh-Wai Wong
reviews.text: If you are a tourist, a ferry trip from Tsim Sha Tsui to Hong Kong Island is a must-do event since you haven’t visited Hong Kong without making this ferry trip. The ferry ride is very affordable so no reason to skip.

reviews.author: Tony Doan
reviews.text: Your exploration of this vibrant metropolis is incomplete without crossing Victoria Harbour by boat from the iconic Tsim Sha Tsui docks.

reviews.author: Mae Shao
reviews.text: The rice porridge is a must-try when visiting Foshan. The ingredients are fresh and unique, making it a rare experience for visitors.

reviews.author: alex lee
reviews.text: Food was exceptional. Deco was nice. Service was excellent. Food hygiene was excellent. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: PiPi Lu
reviews.text: Guangzhou has a long tradition of "eating congee for health." Rice-free congee, with its delicate texture where water and rice are perfectly blended and no rice grains are visible, continues the essence of Cantonese congee's pursuit of a smooth

reviews.author: 周正忠
reviews.text: It's very similar to Wufenpu in Songshan District; the cheap prices will leave you overwhelmed and unsure of what to buy, and everything seems so good—it's terrifying.

reviews.author: Daniel Cheong
reviews.text: Mostly younger fella fashion. Mature adult, don't waste your time here. 98% women apparel. Men apparel goto Shahe Garment Market.

reviews.author: wuan ng
reviews.text: Many shops don't sell individual items. There are lots of clothes, which can be overwhelming.

reviews.author: Pineapple Lover
reviews.text: Chance upon this little restaurant that was recommended by the Michelin Guide for many years, and I can see why! The wonton noodles were really yummy, yet comforting, flavourful, and at a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Alaa Abdallat
reviews.text: I went with a friend for their famous prawn wonton noodle. It DID NOT DISAPPOINT. Just wow, we loved it, the place has a very nice atmosphere, friendly ladies running the place, the food is prepared fast and in an open kitchen setup

reviews.author: fa1
reviews.text: With friendly service, reasonable prices with no overcharging, and fantastic flavors, it’s truly an enchanting restaurant.

reviews.author: Trip.com Member
reviews.text: This hotel was a dream! All around it is photo worthy, then on the inside, a real waterfall with koi fish 🥰 the buffet options are all top-notch, worth the price.

reviews.author: JUAN LIU
reviews.text: I had dim sum at Yu Tang Chun Nuan at the White Swan Hotel during the day, and the overall experience was excellent. The service, in particular, left a lasting impression.

reviews.author: KT Lim
reviews.text: Watch 10 am Martial Art display and Lion Dance by Wong Fei Hong Troup. Together with Ip Man _ Grandmaster of Wing Chun and Ancestral Temple of Emperor Huang Di.

reviews.author: Google Lum
reviews.text: Visited in November recently. Another attraction with historical significance. It is a large complex with various displays including about Huang FeiHong and also martial arts and lion dance performance.

reviews.author: 00Y
reviews.text: Really impressed by the architecture and art in this historical building.
